verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a passing note that Sprinto runs "live regional apps" such as eu.sprinto.com. That implies region-specific hosting (e.g. an EU instance), but nothing documents that a customer can choose or configure where their data is stored. missing for 10: documentation of a user-selectable data region or residency option at signup or in settings, a list of available regions, residency guarantees for stored data and backups, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: The explorer is hosted on the live regional apps (e.g. https://eu.sprinto.com/dev-api/explorer)
